zh.title: 泰雷茲以三地據點服務亞太航空業 看重本地備料與長約
zh.summary: 泰雷茲以新加坡、北京及新德里據點支援亞太機隊，並以與越捷航空的維修合約為例，說明如何透過在地備料縮短等待時間。
body: 泰雷茲（Thales）航空全球服務主管 Thomas Got 在新加坡舉行的 MRO Asia-Pacific 展會受訪時表示，公司以新加坡為亞太營運中心，並在北京及新德里設有據點。據 AeroTime 11月19日刊出的訪談，新德里據點於2025年啟用，部分維修工作也會交由泰雷茲其他地區的中心處理。
Got 指出，備件能否及時交付會影響航空公司排班。泰雷茲的部分合約由公司承諾維持指定設備庫存，與航空公司共同預測需求，讓部件能在區域內調度。
越捷航空今年9月已公布與泰雷茲簽訂按飛行時數計費的維修合約，涵蓋空中巴士 A320 系列與 A330 系列的航電設備。Got 表示，公司希望將這類長期支援模式擴展至其他亞太航空公司。

en.title: Thales outlines three-hub strategy for Asia-Pacific airline maintenance
en.summary: Thales is using sites in Singapore, Beijing and New Delhi to support Asia-Pacific airlines, with local stocks and long-term contracts aimed at cutting waits for parts.
body: Thales aviation services chief Thomas Got told AeroTime at MRO Asia-Pacific in Singapore that the company supports the region from sites in Singapore, Beijing and New Delhi. The New Delhi facility opened in 2025. Some work goes to other repair centers in Thales’s global network.

In the interview published November 19, Got said component availability affects airline schedules. Under some contracts, Thales holds stock for designated equipment and forecasts demand with airline customers so parts can be sourced locally.

Vietjet announced in September that it had signed a repair-by-the-hour agreement with Thales covering avionics on its Airbus A320 and A330 families. Got said Thales aims to extend this type of long-term support to other Asia-Pacific airlines.
